evidence_status_definitions.FAMILY_FDR: OOS gain + independent confirmation + prespecified predictor-family FDR survival.
evidence_status_definitions.GLOBAL_FDR: OOS gain + independent confirmation + global multiple-testing survival.
evidence_status_definitions.OOS_ONLY: Positive OOS gain without independent-overlap confirmation.
evidence_status_definitions.OOS_PLUS_OVERLAP: Positive OOS gain with direction retained in non-overlapping episodes; not FDR significant.

forecast_contract.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg on approximate Fisher-z p-values of non-overlapping Spearman; global and pre-specified predictor-family q-values
forecast_contract.oos_model: univariate or pre-specified two-feature OLS fit only on discovery and frozen in holdout
forecast_contract.raw_level_caution: raw position and raw OI levels are scale-sensitive/nonstationary; percentile and OI-normalized variants are retained as confirmation controls

information_contract.percentiles: expanding history only; current report may enter its own rank but no future report is visible
information_contract.release_anchor: first market close on/after Friday release target
